9c1s: The Master of Business Administration in International Business provides advanced knowledge of business management within a global context. Students explore international strategy, leadership, marketing, finance, operations and organisational management while considering the challenges of operating across different countries and markets. The programme develops an understanding of globalisation, international competition, cultural differences and cross-border business activities. Students can strengthen strategic decision-making, leadership, analytical and communication skills through business cases and practical projects. Graduates can pursue management and leadership opportunities in multinational organisations, international business, consulting, business development and related sectors. The programme can also support entrepreneurial and global career ambitions.
9cm7: This 18-month MBA programme provides postgraduate-level education in business management, leadership, and organisational strategy. Students can study a range of business disciplines, including strategic management, finance, marketing, operations, human resources, leadership, and organisational behaviour. The programme provides opportunities to develop analytical and decision-making skills and understand how management principles can be applied to real business situations. Its duration provides a structured pathway for students to build advanced knowledge while developing practical professional capabilities. The MBA can be suitable for graduates and working professionals seeking career progression, management responsibilities, leadership opportunities, entrepreneurship, consulting, or broader roles within commercial and organisational environments.
